# th-rules/no-isnil-isempty-on-boolean

📝 Disallow _.isNil(...) / _.isEmpty(...) when the argument type is boolean or a union containing boolean (e.g., boolean | undefined, boolean | X).

💼 This rule is enabled in the following configs: ✅ `recommended`, ⚛️ `recommendedReact`, 🟦 `recommendedTypescript`, 🎲 `recommendedTypescriptReact`.
